question_cn: 哪些棋子可以实施牵制战术？
question_en: Which pieces can create a pin?

options.text_cn: 只有车和象，因为它们走直线和斜线
options.text_en: Only rooks and bishops, because they move along ranks, files, and diagonals
Only queens, because the queen is the strongest piece

options.text_cn: 车、象、后——所有走直线或斜线的棋子
options.text_en: Rooks, bishops, and queens — all pieces that move along ranks, files, or diagonals
All pieces, including knights and pawns

explanation_cn: 能实施牵制的棋子必须走直线（横/竖/斜），所以是车（横线和纵线）、象（斜线）、后（横线、纵线和斜线）。马和兵因走法特殊无法形成三点一线的牵制。
explanation_en: Pins require a line attack, so rooks (ranks and files), bishops (diagonals), and queens (both) can pin. Knights and pawns cannot create a pin because their attacks do not follow a line.
